title: Repair a real coronary gap and build a source-linked CPR review package
hypothesis: Given a CTA, a predicted mask, a small review region and named route endpoints, an agent can repair a natural lumen discontinuity while preserving other vessels, trace the intended route and keep rotated CPR and a 3D mesh geometrically consistent.
why_hard: Broad difficulty is not established. A real 5-mm CAS-Net gap is present despite 94.14% whole-mask Dice, but both fixed author baselines pass, including geometry-only repair and tracing. Terra/high also passes repair, trace and mesh; its single failure is stale CPR arc-length metadata after centerline resampling, resolved by one field correction.
next_action: The bounded larger experiment is complete. Retain the working geometry viewer and frozen software-consistency miss as calibration. Do not promote this as a hard anatomical reasoning failure. Any new discrimination experiment needs independently reviewed natural errors and matched intact/absent/variant controls, with a new freeze rather than tighter post-outcome gates.

sources.note: ImageCAS-X benchmark and annotation protocol. Published external segmentation results motivate the source screen; they are distinct from this local agent trial.
Downloaded and checksum-verified case-1 mask, named centerlines, surface, split metadata and CAS-Net weights. Geometry is mask-derived, not independent anatomical truth.
Matched original CTA. Case 1 is in the ImageCAS-X training split; no held-out accuracy claim.
Pinned source and published full-volume inference pipeline, with batch size one and CPU fallback for an unsupported MPS operation.

notes: One normal Terra/high attempt, 484.14 agent seconds, matched oracle/nop controls and identical task digests. Repair adds 103 voxels with zero collateral edits, local Dice 0.9448, centerline p95 distance 0.4996 mm and 100% reference coverage. CPR source positions and HU are accurate, but arc_mm ends at 184.809 mm while the saved line measures 175.918 mm. Replacing arc_mm alone passes the unchanged verifier; original failure remains preserved. Three linked local viewers expose the reference-assisted artifact, public-input image baseline and separately corrected Terra artifact. The earlier BR-026 L-ACA-adjacent disagreement remains unadjudicated after paired-image review and is excluded from clinical failure claims. No publication, submission promotion or additional model trial.
